meaning: Limescale build-up in the heat pump.
causes: Limescale, especially in hard water areas
diySteps: Descale the dishwasher with a dishwasher descaler (Bosch sells its own); follow the product instructions
To help prevent it, use softening salt if your dishwasher has a water softener function
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Bosch gives descaling as the fix. If E12 returns after descaling, contact Bosch Customer Support.
sourceTitle: Bosch Dishwasher Error Codes: Troubleshooting Guide (Bosch)
